system.description: You jab your weapon into your opponent’s torso, then twirl it above your head at rapid speeds manipulating the air pressure around you, pulling nearby enemies in. Make a melee taijutsu attack, on hit, the target takes your weapons damage, then all creatures within your weapons reach+10 feet must a Strength saving throw. Creatures that fail take damage equal to your weapons damage die+5d8 and are pulled 15 feet toward you, or half as much damage on success with no additional effects.
